active_family: native joint AR conditional generator for IV + anchor factors with shared source, shared transition mixer, mixed coordinates, and typed readout heads
current_bottleneck: 658a improves the clean native-joint one-shot plateau but still does not recover the IV-only AR frontier. The remaining issue is not post-hoc gluing or decoder-head expressiveness alone: the model remains undercovered, weakly conditionally useful, level-occupancy biased, and regime-cell coverage poor on the 441-window broad frame.
last_result_summary: 658a added an AR analogue of 652a by extending the 641a mixed-coordinate state-conditioned AR transition with typed IV/factor readout heads while preserving one shared history encoder, source, transition mixer, and rollout. Best epoch 6 reached IV 5/11 on the full suite: daily-change KS 24/25, level KS 7/25, median-bias 12/25, corr ratio 0.750, mean-reversion aggregate ratio 0.986, pathwise max-jump KS 0.480 pass, but failed coverage, conditionality, time_series, regime_coverage, distributional_fidelity, and mean_reversion. Joint audit remained broadly coherent: factor delta KS mean 0.109, factor q99 pass 13/13, factor-factor corr shape 0.892, IV-factor corr shape 0.868, with absolute IV-factor corr attenuated at 0.088 versus GT 0.149.
next_step_recommendation: Do not add another architectural knob yet. Run a narrow post-result diagnostic comparing 641a, 652a, and 658a on loss balance, IV/factor target scale, and conditional MAE/coverage by cell to explain why typed AR improves daily/pathwise realism and preserves factors but still misses conditional coverage and level occupancy.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain the historical short-frame best learned IV laws at 8/11. On the 441-window broad frame, 612a is the highest IV-count native joint run at 6/11 but has a degenerate source-scale mechanism and poor anchor-factor joint audit. 658a is now the cleanest native joint AR baseline: IV 5/11 with coherent factor/joint audit, but still not IV-deployable. 656a remains only a diagnostic stress-deck overlay because it is composed post hoc rather than generated by one mechanism.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
